Quick if you buy the items; weeks if you collect the tokens in the Bigfoot's Burden Quest

The **Soil Guardian** outfit and its two addons are obtained using three gnomish vouchers: the one for the base outfit and the one for the first addon are swapped for {item:Major Crystalline Token|Major} and {item:Minor Crystalline Token|Minor Crystalline Tokens} with {npc:Gnomally} in Gnomegate; the one for the second addon drops, with a bit of luck, from {item:Gnomish Supply Package|Gnomish Supply Packages}. You also get the achievement **Funghitastic**.
